verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the security page's '0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners' and the Enterprise private/dedicated storage options. These imply that third-party AI vendors do not keep, and so cannot train on, meeting data, but nothing states that the data is excluded from model training. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is never used to train AI models, a user- or admin-facing training opt-out control, documentation of Fireflies' own model-training policy, and independent corroboration.
